label: Слушая
description: A 10-sentence card for слушая, the imperfective gerund of слушать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Front position. Слушая is formed from the present stem of слушать (слуша-ют) plus -я. The fronted gerund names the action concurrent with главный verb готовила — she listened while cooking.
Strategic focus: End position. Here слушая closes the sentence and runs parallel to кивал. Both actions belong to the subject он and happen at the same moment.
Strategic focus: Present tense. The main verb запоминаешь is present, and слушая marks the simultaneous manner: listening carefully, you remember everything. The gerund carries no tense ending.
Strategic focus: Same-subject rule. The one who listens in слушая must be the one who takes notes — a single subject студент. A gerund cannot introduce a separate doer of its own action.

missions.phrase: Слушая новости, мы будем пить чай.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future main clause. The main clause is future (будем пить), but слушая stays unchanged — gerunds have no future form. Listening to the news, we will drink tea at the same time.
Strategic focus: Plural subject. Even with the plural subject дети, the form stays слушая — gerunds are indeclinable and take no number ending, unlike the participle слушающие.

missions.phrase: Слушая дождь, она думала о лете.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past main clause. The finite verb думала is past, yet слушая marks concurrency: while listening to the rain, she thought of summer. The imperfective gerund signals overlap, not sequence.

missions.phrase: Слушая совет, не забывай о своём мнении.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperative main clause. The main verb не забывай is a command addressed to ты, the same implied subject as слушая. The gerund keeps its single form regardless of the mood of the finite verb.
Strategic focus: Indeclinable form. With the masculine subject муж the gerund stays слушая, taking no gender or case ending. A participle would inflect; the gerund holds one fixed shape always.
Strategic focus: Two parallel actions. Бабушка is the shared subject of both вязала and слушая, the actions overlapping in time. The gerund compresses while she listened into one indeclinable word.
